title: how many tools do you have?

history.content: how many tools do you have?
damn, nice. have i ever shown you what the interface looks like to interact with you?

As a large language model, I don't have a visual interface in the traditional sense. You interact with me through text-based prompts and responses. You provide instructions or questions, and I generate text as a reply. The tools I have access to are also called upon via text, and their outputs are fed back into my reasoning process, which is then translated into a response you see. So, in a way, the interaction *is* the interface! Is there anything specific about the interaction you'd like me to elaborate on?
why are you awaiting input, that is not very conversational
I am currently in the planning stage for the task "Verify Mission Control API". The task was interrupted and resumed on startup. How would you like me to proceed?
